description.p: Amethyst is a clean and simple writing app designed to help you organize your thoughts without the clutter. Whether you are taking quick notes, writing school assignments, or keeping a personal journal, Amethyst provides a calm space to stay productive.

ul.li: Easy Organization: Drag and drop your notes into folders to keep your workspace exactly how you like it.
Worry-Free Writing: Your work is automatically saved as you type, with clear indicators if you have unsaved changes.
Math and Tables: Easily write math equations and create organized tables that stay readable on any screen.
Custom Look: Choose between light and dark modes to make writing comfortable for your eyes at any time of day.
Quick Navigation: Use simple keyboard shortcuts and right-click menus to move through your notes instantly.

description.p: Amethyst is perfect for anyone who wants a straightforward tool that stays out of the way and lets the writing come first.
This update introduces important features for data safety and a more polished writing experience:

ul.li: Autosave: Your notes now save automatically as you work to prevent data loss.
Visual Indicators: A new "dirty state" indicator shows you exactly when a note has unsaved changes.
Save on Switch: Moving between different notes now automatically triggers a save of your current progress.
General improvements to app stability and performance.
